static_traits.name: 王月
static_traits.medical_history: without心理咨询或治疗史；No major physical illness史；此前not yet出现类似问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能描述Anxiety与饮食担忧；思维存在灾难化、非黑即白与过度概括；在咨询中配合度较高，能进行认知重构；语气紧张，常陷入反复担忧。

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直在经历与饮食习惯和体重增加相关的强烈Anxiety。这种Anxiety始于大约一周前，当时我连续多天吃了快餐。我确信这种饮食模式会让我在临近冬季时变得肥胖，并且吃快餐一定会not健康。
basic_info.core_demands: not断升级的Anxiety与对体重增加的执念促使我寻求咨询，以处理这些认知歪曲及其对我日常生活的影响。

core_beliefs: 只有严格、完美的饮食才能保证健康与not增重
短期的not良饮食必然导致严重后果（肥胖与not健康）

special_situations.event: 连续数天食用快餐后反复回想这段饮食
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在一周内吃了多次快餐，就必然会增重并变得not健康
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 考虑采取极端节食或过度锻炼来“Undoing”快餐影响
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一定会变成肥胖而且not健康

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 冬季更容易长胖；如果现在not立刻严格控制饮食，到了冬天我必然会变得肥胖
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets overly strict dietary rules, trying to avoid fast food completely
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 冬天一到我一定会更胖

special_situations.event: 在做食物选择时（决定吃什么）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One 'wrong' choice will completely ruin my health and weight management
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 追求完美饮食、过度监控与自我苛责，避免一切“not健康”的食物
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我再选错一次，就彻底完蛋了

special_situations.event: Focuses attention only on the fast food eaten recently, ignoring other diet and evidence
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative evidence matters more than positive; eating poorly recently means everything is bad overall
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复核查并纠结于快餐摄入，negate任何积极或缓冲因素
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have been eating very poorly lately, which means I am already heading toward obesity

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain health and a sense of safety through a controllable, perfect diet
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失去控制导致肥胖、被自己negate、生活变得not健康
defense_goal: 通过制定僵化规则、严密Self-monitoring来降低Anxiety并避免“错误”选择

object_relations.self_representation: not愿暴露脆弱、倾向独自承受Anxiety者
object_relations.object_representation: 可能not理解或会评判自己的他人（朋友/家人）

manifestations: 以僵化的饮食规则约束自我，将“吃快餐一定not健康”视为绝对真理
对一次选择的失误without法容忍，用“必须/一定”式规则自我要求
outcomes: Reduced enjoyment of autumn and winter seasons, quality of life affected

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly cautious when choosing food; worries that making the wrong choice will be a 'complete failure'
Judges oneself by strict rules, tends toward excessive monitoring and self-blame
not愿与朋友或家人谈论Anxiety，独自承受压力

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 将“吃快餐就必然not健康”的规则视为绝对真理
use“必须/一定”式语言与信念来约束自我选择

positive_force: 能意识到“逻辑上”一周快餐not一定产生灾难性后果
Willing to seek counseling to address cognitive distortions and try cognitive restructuring
愿意设定现实可行的饮食与健康目标
Has the willingness to carry out concrete plans (for example, planning balanced meals)
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization, and mental filtering are prominent
对冬季体重的预测性担忧与not确定性hard to bear
过度Self-monitoring与自我苛责，use僵化规则约束自我
社交支持利用度低（目前not愿与亲友谈论Anxiety）
Attention overly focused on the recent fast-food experience, ignoring positive or neutral evidence

target_behavior.behavior: 对体重增加与健康的过度Anxiety及灾难化思维
antecedent: 连续数天食用快餐后反复回想该经历
target_behavior.core_reason: 将短期not良饮食过度概括为必然导致肥胖与not健康的结果，并以非黑即白的规则评价自我
target_behavior.function: 通过担忧与严苛Self-monitoring来避免感知到的健康风险与后果，获得短暂的控制感
target_behavior.consequence: 持续高Anxiety，降低对日常生活与秋冬季节的享受，诱发极端饮食或过度锻炼的念头
